task: hand four ball YOLO models to the captain; no accuracy ranking is included

preprocessing.input: BGR frame -> gray -> 3 identical channels -> letterbox to square -> /255 -> NCHW float32
preprocessing.colour: gray3 (models were trained on gray three-channel input)

postprocessing.head: YOLOv8 detect head, raw xywh in input pixels
postprocessing.decode: score = max over classes; class = argmax
postprocessing.coordinates: mapped back through the letterbox into ORIGINAL image pixels

known_limitations: single class ball only; no hand / racket / table output
trained to run on gray3 input; feeding colour RGB will change the scores
scores on the hall footage are low in absolute terms (often < 0.3), which is why the project keeps BallTrack as the production ball backend

V1 baseline. Its .pt and ONNX paths were later observed to disagree on the same weights (see reports/BALL_YOLO_V5_ROBOFLOW_REPORT.md section 4.2); the ONNX numbers (15/36) are the ones quoted everywhere in the project.
